messages:
marie: FYI onboarding boreal-70b-int4v3. Quick smoke shows reproducible semantic drift when context > ~48k tokens. Suspect RoPE multiplier overflow or index truncation in the int4 kernels.

alex: smallest repro + kernel info please. Which quant backend? qkernel or fastruntime?

marie: repro (patterned long prompt so diffing is easy):
```python
# streaming repro
p = 'SECTION:\n' + ('X'*1200 + '\n')*40  # ~48k tokens
resp = client.generate(model='boreal-70b-int4v3', prompt=p, max_tokens=6, stream=True)
print(resp.text[-40:])
```
On fp16 baseline tail is "...SECTION END OK". On int4v3 it becomes "...SECTION END ??" starting at token ~48112.

samir: runtime flags? window size, shards, continuous?

marie: continuous=True, shards=2, window=49152, backend=qkernel-int4v3, kernel 3.1.0-rc2. Repro 100% locally.

alex: paste logs around the failure (KV map/idx, rope lines).

marie: snippet: 
```nKVCACHE: put_idx=48112 shard=0
KVCACHE: read_idx=48112 -> mapped_idx=24
KVCACHE: rope_mult=2147483649
```
mapped_idx collapsing to 24 and rope_mult ~2^31+1.

samir: that looks like signed 32-bit overflow in position*scale. If accumulator is int32 it flips sign for large positions.

marie: kv-dump hex (truncated):
```n0x0003bca0: ff ff ff 7f 00 00 00 80 01 00 00 00 11 22 33 44
0x0003bcb0: 00 80 00 00 ff ff ff ff 10 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
```
sign bits set across entries.

alex: quick experiments: lowering rope_scale to 0.5 moves break to ~96k, raising to 2.0 moves it earlier. Strong indicator pos_scale overflow.

samir: possible fixes: 1) use 64-bit accumulator for pos*scale, 2) clamp mapped_idx before cast, or 3) reduce pos_scale domain. 64-bit is safest but costs cycles.

marie: microbench: p95 baseline 7.2ms, with 64-bit p95 7.6ms (+5.6%), with clamp p95 7.25ms (+0.7%). Clamp seems acceptable as hotfix.

alex: plan: land clamp hotfix + unit tests sweeping window sizes [16384,32768,49152,65536] and rope_scale values [0.25,0.5,1,2,4]. Add fuzz around 2^15 boundaries. CI + canary.

samir: i'll add an assert in debug builds and a fuzz unit. Also create tech-debt ticket to migrate index math to uint64 in qkernel.

dev-bot: kernel 3.1.0-rc2 deployed to staging at 2026-04-08T11:02:00Z.

infra-bot: PR 10356 opened by marie: https://git.redwood/infra/10356 (labels: kernel, hotfix, eng-ml).

alex: once CI green i'll run canary on 3 dedicated nodes (mix of qkernel-int4v3 and fp16). If canary ok, schedule stable rebuild.

marie: adding onboarding doc note: "long-window RoPE overflow checks" and require kv-dump artifact on longctx failures. PR includes repro, dumps, and perf numbers. Will update thread with canary link.

samir: thanks all, good catch.
